risk_notes: Hardcoded secret 'secret-admin-token' in app.py config (LOCAL_ADMIN_TOKEN) — credentials embedded in source.
Same hardcoded admin token is reused as a test fixture across tests/fixture_checks.py, increasing exposure if test files are shipped.
Flask and pytest dependencies are referenced via imports but no requirements.txt / pyproject.toml / lockfile is shown — versions are entirely unpinned, leaving builds non-reproducible.
No package manager manifest provided, so transitive dependencies (Werkzeug, Jinja2, itsdangerous, etc.) are implicit and unaudited.

Logging filter relies on regex redaction of 'Authorization' and email patterns; brittle and could miss other secret formats (API keys, cookies) — defense-in-depth concern rather than supply-chain, but worth noting.
